measurement.what: Only the active pod's receive (bus) connection cut silently, its lease connection up; time until a standby delivers (for INFRA-14)
measurement.result: cut -> standby takes the lease 602.4 s; its settle hold ended 602.7 s and it handled the durable's backlog at once. The holder noticed the cut at 2.0-2.5 s (#2542) and answered /healthz 503 from 2.8 s, but kept renewing the lease on its live lease connection; the take-over came only when self-health reached its threshold (20 consecutive failed probes 30 s apart) and terminated the process, which released the lease. No pod delivered from the durable during those 10 minutes.
measurement.control: 18194add: no disconnect noticed and no take-over within the 300 s bound
measurement.caveat: After the take-over, deliveries failed with 'no session record for session ses_c' because the throwaway script registered the session once and its 5-minute record lapsed; ordering after this run is unverified.

risks: A silent cut of only the holder's receive connection, with its lease connection up, stalls delivery for about 10 minutes (602 s), until self-health terminates the holder: the lease is renewed on a connection the receive loop does not depend on. A frozen hub or a lost node cuts both connections and takes over in about 5 s (11 s to first delivery). Sent to the architect to decide whether this is acceptable or the holder must give up the lease when its receive connection is lost.
